license_policy: Two independent CC0 valley-brook and crashing-ocean field recordings; verification source links included; original WAV source is NOT downloaded
media_quality_policy: Public Freesound HQ MP3 previews are lossy; actual bitrate varies and the first 18MB of any long preview cannot establish its true full-file bitrate. The 192 kbps audition MP3 is a transcoding step and cannot restore quality. Do not publish without listening approval; original lossless WAV recordings remain separate.
goal: Two P0 audition masters; Bamboo Water Fountain NEW-11 not included due unverified/unsuitable CC0 recordings. Review only; no production source IDs or SEO URL promotion

tracks.title: Bodetal Brook & Birds — Bubbling Brook Candidate
tracks.creator: Borgory
tracks.notes: Stereo field source from Harz/Bodetal valley in Germany, recorded Zoom H5. Description calls stream in distance with bird calls. NOT proven close-up bubbling brook: owner must compare with existing Forest Stream and decide if named Bubbling Brook is acoustically appropriate; otherwise reject or retitle. Unique 605s segment.
tracks.arrangement: 600s contiguous section with a 5s circular seam; selected from a longer independent field recording
tracks.preview_acquisition_note: First up to 18,000,000 bytes requested from a 10m37s HQ MP3 preview; independent source selected 605s. Filename and full-source duration derived from original CC0 Freesound page; original lossless WAV not downloaded.
limitations: Original lossless source NOT downloaded; publicly accessible HQ preview is lossy
Review listening needed: source identity, tonality, abrupt events, peak, physical listening comfort, 10min loop

tracks.title: Crashing Ocean Waves — Wakanui Beach, New Zealand
tracks.creator: Desmond178
tracks.notes: Actual 45m26s stereo breaking waves at Wakanui Beach, Ashburton NZ. Original source is CC0. Compare with approved Gentle Ocean Waves (Scottish shore): must be significantly stronger; audit background wind, occasional transient and seam. Selected unique 605s segment.
tracks.arrangement: 600s contiguous section with a 5s circular seam; selected from a longer independent field recording
tracks.preview_acquisition_note: Range/byte-capped HQ MP3 preview (up to 18,000,000 bytes) from a 45m26s original. FFprobe duration may use a full-file Xing/ID3 header, while local bytes are partial; bitrate inferred from file size and that header is INVALID and intentionally left null. The first >605 seconds were decoded for audition.
limitations: Original lossless source NOT downloaded; publicly accessible HQ preview is lossy
Review listening needed: source identity, tonality, abrupt events, peak, physical listening comfort, 10min loop
